label: prop:knot-operator-energy-exists
title: Existence of the knot operator energy
html:
For any partition \lambda \vdash k with k \leq k_{\max} and any q in the generic locus \{q \in R : [k]_q! \neq 0 \;\forall k \leq k_{\max}\}, the knot operator energy E(\lambda, q) = |u_\lambda(q)| exists as an element of the absolute-value image |R| of the base ring.

Proof. The shadow price u_\lambda(q) = w_\lambda(q)/d_\lambda(q) - 1/[k]_q! \in R is a rational function of q with denominator [k]_q! \cdot d_\lambda(q). Both are nonzero on the generic locus by mass-coefficient-shadow-price. The absolute value |\cdot|: R \to |R| is well-defined for:

  • R = \mathbb{R}: archimedean |\cdot|_\infty, image \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0};
  • R = \mathbb{Q}_p: p-adic |\cdot|_p, image \{p^{-n}\} \cup \{0\};
  • R = \mathbb{F}_p: the only absolute value is the trivial one, so there is no archimedean place. The energy filtration is undefined and confinement falls back to ILP feasibility (stable atom).

In each archimedean or non-archimedean case, E(\lambda, q) exists and is uniquely determined by \lambda and q.
